gloss: sign of people; presence of people

definitions.gloss: sign of people; presence of people
definitions.explanation: The feeling that people are around. Almost always negative: {人気|ひとけ}がない (deserted, with nobody about) and {人気|ひとけ}のない{道|みち} (a deserted road).

examples.english: The park is deserted at night.
Walking alone on a deserted road is scary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人気|ひとけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、しんと⟦{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}っていた→静まり返る：14630_shizumarikaeru⟧。
examples.english: On the holiday the office was empty of people and completely silent.

notes:
WRITING:
- Also written {人|ひと}け, which avoids confusion with {人気|にんき} (popularity), the same kanji read にんき.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人気|ひとけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: deserted, nobody about
- {人気|ひとけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧〜: deserted ~ ({人気|ひとけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧, {人気|ひとけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧)

WATCH OUT:
- {人気|ひとけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (nobody around) and {人気|にんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (unpopular) are written the same; only the context and the reading tell them apart.
